name: prosody
summary: a browser-based speech studio with inline emotion tags, pitch and pacing controls, reusable presets, and a segment timeline. edge-TTS supplies the online base voice; an optional local RVC stage handles voice conversion.
problem: Give a script more controllable delivery through inline emotion tags and reusable voice settings, with an optional voice-conversion stage.
highlights: Emotion-tagged scripts: Split text into segments using tags and highlight each segment in the editor. Untagged passages use a default emotion.
Prosody Lab: Tune pitch, speed, and volume, preview the result, and save the configuration as a reusable emotion preset.
Audio timeline: Generate segment audio, follow it on a timeline, and export the combined result. Optional RVC conversion changes voice character.

Tone Editor before synthesis, showing the pitch, loudness, and pacing editing workflow.

sections.heading: The workflow
sections.body:
- Write a script with emotion tags.
- Tune and preview the delivery presets.
- Choose the voice and optionally enable an RVC model.
- Generate, review the timeline, and download audio.

sections.heading: Under the hood
sections.body: FastAPI serves a plain JavaScript interface. The pipeline parses segments, calls Edge-TTS, optionally applies local RVC, then uses FFmpeg for audio processing and export. JSON files persist settings.

sections.heading: Scope & current state
sections.body: The base voice uses the online Edge-TTS service. RVC runs locally and requires a compatible model and environment; emotion tags control configured delivery parameters.
